name: Currency | A currency that records use can be deleted
description_html:
Summary

A currency can be deleted from Settings while records are saved in it. No warning is shown, and the records keep pointing at a currency that no longer exists.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM: staging-crm.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, account ndc-staging-owner
  • Zoho CRM (reference): test org, checked live in Edge
  • Date: 17 Nov 2026

Steps to reproduce

  1. Add USD in Settings › Company Settings › Currencies (rate 50).
  2. Create a Deal in USD with Amount 1000.
  3. Delete USD from the currencies list.
  4. Open the deal.

Expected result

A currency that has been added can only be deactivated, not deleted. Zoho CRM states: "The added currency can only be deactivated and cannot be deleted." Deactivating warns that the currency can't be used for new records, and old records keep it.

Actual result

  • The delete succeeds (204) with no warning.
  • USD disappears from the currencies list.
  • The deal still shows Currency USD at rate 50.

Evidence

Annotated image attached (TAVI API results next to Zoho's warning).
